FIXED in 19e1f61af: wmi_query reports its error; the sentinel path declares unavailable/permission_denied/constrained through the host-tested mapping. A genuinely empty result stays undeclared. The Windows branch itself is only exercised on a real host (the pure mapping is unit-tested).
